```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { isoquant, minimiseCost } from "./cobb-douglas.js"

viewof A = Inputs.range([0.5, 3], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Productivity, A"})
viewof crs = Inputs.toggle({label: "Constant returns to scale"})
viewof a = Inputs.range([0.1, 1], {value: 0.5, step: 0.05, label: "Labour exponent, a"})
viewof bFree = Inputs.range([0.1, 1], {value: 0.5, step: 0.05, label: "Capital exponent, b"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
b = crs ? 1 - a : bFree
bNote = crs ? `b = 1 − a = ${b.toFixed(2)}.` : ""
p = ({A, a, b})

// With constant returns, hide the slider for b and stop a at 0.9, to keep b above 0.
constrain = {
  const aMax = crs ? 0.9 : 1
  viewof bFree.style.display = crs ? "none" : ""
  viewof a.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(input => input.max = aMax)
  if (a > aMax) {
    viewof a.value = aMax
    viewof a.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}))
  }
}

levels = d3.range(2, 42, 2)    // output quantities with an isoquant drawn

scale = a + b
returns = Math.abs(scale - 1) < 1e-9 ? "constant" : scale > 1 ? "increasing" : "decreasing"
```
